headline: 6 vault contracts catalogued across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and Avalanche; no GitHub, no audits, no deployed-contracts doc found
short_headline: 6 vaults across 4 chains; no docs or audits

findings.text: D1: Block-explorer name-tag search not directly executed (fetch allowlist blocked direct Etherscan fetches for undiscovered addresses). Vault addresses for Ethereum and Avalanche were discovered via third-party index (tradingstrategy.ai). No Etherscan name-tag result for 'Gami Labs' was directly fetched.
D2: gamilabs.io/vaults page is JS-rendered; static fetch returned no vault addresses or deployed-contracts listing. No canonical deployed-contracts doc URL was found on the website or docs.

D3: No audit links are pinned in the protocol context and none were surfaced from the website or any search result. Gami Labs claims 'audited vault architecture' on the homepage but links only to third-party infrastructure (Lagoon, Upshift) with no audit PDF or report URL discoverable this run.
D4: No GitHub repository is recorded for Gami Labs; the protocol.github field is empty and no GitHub link was found on the website or in search results. No deployment artifacts available.

D5: Multi-chain enumeration: Ethereum (2 vaults found via tradingstrategy.ai), Arbitrum (1 vault), Base (1 vault), Avalanche (2 vaults). Stellar, Flare, Robinhood Chain, and Hemi — zero addresses surfaced from any source tried.
D6: No factory contract identified. Vaults appear deployed via Lagoon Finance and T3tris/Euler infrastructure directly; no factory enumeration view was available to call.

D7: All discovered addresses are vault contracts (role: vault) deployed by or attributed to Gami as curator. Actor class is unknown pending on-chain reads. No multisig, timelock, owner, or proxy_admin addresses surfaced this run.

D8: All 6 addresses trace to the tradingstrategy.ai curator page fetch (evidence index 5); the lvlUSD vault address also confirmed by the dedicated vault page fetch (evidence index 4). All 6 are included in admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Walked gamilabs.io (website + vaults page), Lagoon Finance app, tradingstrategy.ai curator and vault pages. Discovered 6 vault contract addresses across 4 chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum One, Base, Avalanche C-chain). No GitHub repo, audit PDF, deployed-contracts doc, or governance forum found. Stellar, Flare, Robinhood Chain, and Hemi chains show zero addresses. grade=unknown because no on-chain reads were performed (addresses discovered mid-run, no pre-built surfacer URLs, and direct Etherscan/defipunkd fetches were blocked for freshly discovered addresses).

Vaults listing page for Gami Labs is JS-rendered; static fetch returned a table scaffold with no vault addresses, chain info, or contract addresses populated.

protocol_metadata.about: Gami Labs is an institutional DeFi vault curator and risk manager that enables users to deposit stablecoins (primarily USDC) into actively managed vaults across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and Avalanche. Vaults are built on third-party vault infrastructure including Lagoon Finance (ERC-7540 async vaults), Euler, and T3tris, with strategies dynamically rebalanced across lending markets (Aave, Morpho, Silo), liquidity engines (Curve), and structured yield markets (Pendle, Spectra). The protocol claims multi-signature governance and HSM (Hardware Security Module) security, alongside real-time threat detection via Hypernative. Gami Labs is associated with Gami Capital, a separate regulated capital management entity.
